mapper.sql: o.id organization_id,o.name organization_name,o.status organization_status, e.id evidence_id,e.organization_id evidence_organization_id,e.verification,e.enabled,c.reason,c.actor recorded_by,e.recorded_at

FROM person_organization o LEFT JOIN point_organization_acceptance q ON q.organization_id=o.id LEFT JOIN point_acceptance_evidence e ON e.id=q.evidence_id LEFT JOIN point_acceptance_command c ON c.evidence_id=e.id
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM point_acceptance_evidence WHERE organization_id=#{organization}

SELECT id,actor,organization_id,command_key,expected_version,enabled,reason,result_json,evidence_id,recorded_at FROM point_acceptance_command WHERE actor=#{actor} AND organization_id=#{organization} AND command_key=#{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_organization_acceptance(organization_id,evidence_id) VALUES(#{organizationId},#{evidenceId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evidence_id=VALUES(evidence_id)
